description: Rows of the CodeMeta 3.1 mapping export that do not read their crosswalk cell: the cell is prose, empty, wrong, or the format has no crosswalk. 'cell' is the crosswalk cell the row was written for, left out when the format has no crosswalk; when the cell changes the row is reported as CURATED_STALE. 'reason' becomes the row's source as curated:<reason>. Format: docs/mapping-export.md.
